group.label: Simplify Magento sales tax with TaxCloud integration
group.comment:
TaxCloud’s integration with Magento (now Adobe Commerce) makes sales tax automation easy, covering everything from calculation to collection and filing. Automate the entire process from calculation to filing, removing the need for manual data entry.

Easy setup

You can get started with TaxCloud without having to code or make customizations. Just configure your products with the proper tax codes and TaxCloud will charge the right amount of tax on every transaction.

Filing and remittance on your behalf

Send us your sales tax data at the end of the month and we’ll file your sales tax returns for you. You can do this manually by uploading your Orders Report to our secure platform – or through an automatic upload via our Integration.

Simplify economic nexus

Economic nexus is the point where your sales have exceeded revenue or transaction threshold determined by a state. After reaching economic nexus in a state, you’re required to charge and remit sales tax in that state. Send us your sales report and we’ll tell you exactly where you’ve reached nexus and where you’re getting close.

Support with setting up sales tax collection

You can ask our customer support team (powered by actual human beings – not bots) anything. Industry leading US-based support is what makes TaxCloud stand out among sales tax compliance software providers.

TaxCloud simplifies sales tax compliance for businesses of all sizes. With over 15 years of experience and trusted by 2,000+ customers, TaxCloud ensures you can calculate, collect, and file your sales taxes accurately across all 13,000+ US jurisdictions. Say goodbye to manual reporting and let TaxCloud handle your sales tax filing, saving you hours.

field.label: Logging
field.comment:
Enable - Basic: basic information about the module's behavior, useful for day to day usage with logrotate on.
Enable - Advanced: logs more data, including full requests and responses. Useful for debugging, not suitable for day to day usage due to large volumes of data.
Disable: no logs.

field.label: Verify Address
field.tooltip: Use TaxCloud's VerifyAddress API call (Disable if your shipping module handles this)

field.label: API Type
field.tooltip: V3 REST is TaxCloud's current API and the default for new installs. V1 SOAP (legacy) remains available for existing integrations. Each API type uses its own credentials below.

field.label: API Key
field.comment: Optional if V1 SOAP credentials are configured — they are exchanged automatically. Generate a key in your TaxCloud dashboard under Developer → API to use direct key authentication.

field.label: Connection ID
field.comment: The UUID of your Custom API connection, found in your TaxCloud dashboard under Integrations → Custom API (e.g. 25eb9b97-5acb-492d-b720-c03e79cf715a). The connection determines whether requests are processed as test or production.

field.label: Guest Customer ID
field.tooltip: Customer ID to use for guests (Default -1)

field.label: Default TIC
field.tooltip: Default TIC if not specified per product (Default 00000)

field.label: Shipping TIC
field.tooltip: Shipping TIC (Use 11010 if you charge only postage, and 11000 for shipping & handling)

field.label: Cache Lifetime
field.tooltip: API cache lifetime (Default 86400 = 24h, use 0 to disable)

field.label: API Timeout (seconds)
field.tooltip: Max seconds to wait for a TaxCloud API call before failing fast (Default 10). Lower values fail over to the Magento fallback sooner; leave blank to use the default.

field.label: WSDL Endpoint
field.tooltip: Advanced: the TaxCloud SOAP endpoint. Leave at the default unless TaxCloud support directed you to a sandbox or staging endpoint. Clearing this field restores the production default.

field.label: Fallback to Magento Tax Rates
field.tooltip: When enabled, if TaxCloud tax lookup fails, the system will fall back to Magento's default tax calculation

field.label: Only do tax calculations without further Taxcloud integration
field.comment: Useful for merchants that push orders to other systems (i.e. Quickbooks) that are themselves connected to Taxcloud.

field.label: Capture in TaxCloud
field.tooltip: On order creation: at checkout (default; canceled orders may reach TaxCloud). On payment: when invoice is paid (recommended to avoid canceled orders). On shipment: when shipment is created.

field.label: Enable Exemption Certificates
field.comment: Lets exempt customers hold TaxCloud exemption certificates and apply them at checkout. TaxCloud does not verify exemption claims — you remain responsible for holding valid certificates on file.

field.label: Exempt Customer Groups
field.comment: Customers in these groups have a covering certificate applied automatically, and are the only ones allowed to create certificates themselves. Putting a customer in one of these groups is how you vouch for them.

field.label: Restrict to Exempt Groups
field.comment: Hide the exemption interface from everyone outside the groups above. Recommended on storefronts that also sell to consumers.

field.label: Company Name
field.comment: Your business name, recorded on certificates customers create as the seller they are claiming exemption from.
